text: {"overall_winner":"B","qualities":[{"evidence":"clear opening stance on driverless cars","quality":"thesis clarity","description":"It states a definite position early so the reader knows exactly what the argument will defend."},{"evidence":"explains why cars are not necessary and humans need driving skills","quality":"argument development","description":"It builds a more sustained line of reasoning instead of mostly listing opinions and safety concerns."},{"evidence":"mentions construction sites, accidents, naps, being drunk, and malfunction","quality":"supporting elaboration","description":"It uses multiple concrete examples to flesh out its claim and show why someone might oppose driverless cars."},{"evidence":"“Now on the other side of the argument”","quality":"counterargument handling","description":"It acknowledges the opposing view before rebutting it, which makes the argument more balanced and persuasive."},{"evidence":"“As humans have developed...” through “robots taking over our world”","quality":"organizational coherence","description":"It follows a more unified progression from general claim to reasons to conclusion, making the essay easier to follow."}]}
